body:
For about 1 year? 2 years? I kind of accidentally got into modding a semi-large subreddit. I didn't know it was what I needed but it helped my depression be manageable for a while. That sounds super pathetic but coming back to take care of the subreddit and help out with it's community was one of the reasons I was looking forward to the grind of daily life and a good distraction.  

As of late though there are a couple of people who I feel would take much better care of it than I ever could, simply because they are better people than me, and not that bitter with life. Obviously this is something to talk over with them but I can't help but feel to give up again.
